policy.comparison: All prompts and complete models are public. Attempting before opening comparison is voluntary.
policy.records: Keep a first response, comparison notes and corrected response as three named worksheet files; the packet creates no learner-store records.
policy.freshness: These are newly authored source forms, not unseen evidence reserves. Timing, independence and tool use are learner declarations.
policy.review: Independent LLM derivations and source review support the supplied teaching keys. Human, learner and assistive-technology observations remain separate optional work.
policy.scope: The 18 forms sit outside the stable 1,059 numbered written problems and add no bank number, assessment grade or programme allocation.
